identitySignals: GuideStar lists the legal name 'Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc', also known as The Unity Council, in Oakland, CA (EIN 94-1670490). This matches the agenda name and its 'dba The Unity Council'.

The Unity Council's own website lists its main office at 1900 Fruitvale Avenue, Oakland, and the site footer links to the same GuideStar EIN profile. The website and the registry are the same organization.

The Unity Council runs Head Start and Early Head Start early childhood programs in Oakland. This matches OUSD's 'Early Childhood Education' services agreement funded by the Child Development (CSPP) program.
The Unity Council's Facebook page mentions OUSD. I did not fetch that page, so I did not count it as a signal.
research.notes: I did not find the California Secretary of State entity number or the SAM.gov UEI, so both are null. The address is copied exactly as the Unity Council's contact page shows it. The phone number is the main line on that page. The email is the general administrative inbox on that page.

profile.legalName: Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc
profile.summary: The Unity Council is a nonprofit based in the Fruitvale neighborhood of Oakland. It works to promote social equity and improve quality of life in the community. Its programs include affordable housing, early childhood education (Head Start and Early Head Start), and services for families and seniors.

review.notes: The GuideStar profile gives the legal name Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc (EIN 94-1670490) at 1900 Fruitvale Ave Ste 2A in Oakland, and says the group runs Head Start, Early Head Start and CSPP early childhood programs. That matches OUSD's CSPP-funded Early Childhood Education agreement with the dba The Unity Council. The summary is neutral and backed by the homepage, which calls it a non-profit in Fruitvale whose mission is to promote social equity and improve quality of life. The phone, general admin email, address and website all appear on the cited contact page.
